actions.description: Search Phase One School's published course catalog. Read-only. Filter with a free-text query (matches titles, descriptions, outcomes and tags); with no query it lists the whole catalog. Returns structured matches — name, course_id, description, tags, instructors, page path — and navigates the page to the catalog results so the user sees the same list. Returns an empty list when nothing matches.

Get full detail for one Phase One School course: description, learning outcomes, instructors and the complete syllabus (chapters with lesson titles), plus the signed-in learner's enrollment status. Read-only. Pass course as a name or a course_id from search_courses; the page navigates to that course so the user sees it.

Enroll the signed-in learner in a Phase One School course through the school's own enrollment flow (free enrollment — no payment). State-changing: the course is added to the learner's personal learning trail, its lessons unlock, and the page shows the enrolled state. Pass course as a name or course_id from search_courses. If already enrolled, returns current progress instead of enrolling twice. If a course name is ambiguous, it returns the candidates and enrolls nothing — retry with the exact course_id.

The signed-in learner's personal learning state at Phase One School: every enrolled course with completed/total lessons, progress percent and the next lesson to take. Read-only, session-scoped — no arguments needed. Pass resume ("latest" or a course name/course_id) to also navigate the page to that course's next lesson so the learner continues where they left off. "latest" means the most recently listed enrollment.
